items.a: Pig Latin is a language game where English words are altered according to simple rules. It's been used for centuries as a fun way to create playful, coded speech. Despite the name, it has nothing to do with pigs or Latin!

items.q: How do I speak Pig Latin?
items.a: For words starting with consonants, move the consonant(s) to the end and add 'ay'. For words starting with vowels, simply add 'yay' to the end. For example: 'hello' becomes 'ellohay' and 'apple' becomes 'appleyay'.

items.q: Can I decode Pig Latin back to English?
items.a: Yes! Use the 'Pig Latin → English' mode to translate back. Our algorithm reverses the transformation to give you the original text.

items.q: Why is it called Pig Latin?
items.a: The origin of the name is unclear. It may be because the altered words sound like nonsense or 'pig-like' grunting to those unfamiliar with it. The 'Latin' part likely refers to it being a 'secret language' like Latin was to common people.
